messages:
jamal: Heads-up — holding the promo for v0.23.1. Staging e2e spiked and artifact upload timed out on the final step (job ci/staging-publish). Not safe to promote right now.

alex: Ugh. Any logs? Is it the test flake or the registry?

deploy-bot: Promotion blocked: ci/staging-publish failed (exit 1). See run: https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/55678

maria: I looked through the logs — two things: e2e failures (chat-integration tests) are flaky but spike is recent; artifact registry returned 504 on push. Error: "POST /api/v1/upload 504 Gateway Timeout"

sophia: We're also seeing a lot of cache TTL expirations for the wheels cache in the runners, which can cause slower uploads and race with registry timeouts. Re-running without clearing cache just repeats the timeouts.

alex: Can we retry the publish job only? Or do we need to clear the cache on the runners first?

maria: Retry once after clearing cache on the affected runners. If it still fails, we should pin to last-good image and manual-promote during the change window. Change window for this release is 14:00–15:30 UTC.

ops: I can clear the cache on the three staging runners now. Command I run: 
```bash
ssh runner-12 sudo systemctl stop runner
rm -rf /var/cache/ci/wheels/*
systemctl start runner
```
I'll coordinate with infra.

jamal: OK ops, go ahead. If retry fails, what's the manual-promote procedure? I don't want to block GH release notes.

deploy-bot: Manual promote requires a pinned image digest and an approve by two people with write perms. Use: `/deploy promote --image redwood/api@sha256:<digest> --env prod --manual`

alex: Is there a recent known-good digest? Last-green on canary was sha256:9f3b2a1d. QA confirmed it earlier today.

maria: Correct — 9f3b2a1d is last-good. Pinning to that will skip the new artifacts. Tradeoff: missing the tiny bugfix in v0.23.1 but keeps release window intact.

sophia: Also want to flag the root cause: artifact-registry had a brief incident with increased latency from 12:45–12:55 UTC which likely coincided with the publish step. I'll open an infra issue to correlate metrics (registry latency, runner CPU, cache misses).

jamal: Timeline: ops clears cache (in progress), then single retry of ci/staging-publish. If still fails within 20m we pin to 9f3b2a1d and manual-promote at 13:50 UTC so we hit the change window. Who can approve the pin?

maria: I can approve +1, alex can +2. I will also update the release notes to mention we pinned due to artifact push timeouts and we'll follow up with a postmortem.

alex: +1, available to approve. Please include the test spike details in the notes so product knows the risk.

deploy-bot: ci/staging-publish retriggered by jamal (run 55679).

sophia: Run 55679 shows upload still timing out — same 504 at 12:53:10 UTC. Suggest we pin now and avoid chasing flake during the window.

jamal: Agreed. We're pinning to sha256:9f3b2a1d and doing manual promote. maria please update release notes and ops please perform manual promote using deploy-bot command.

ops: Performing manual promote now. Running: `/deploy promote --image redwood/api@sha256:9f3b2a1d --env prod --manual`

deploy-bot: Manual promote initiated by ops. Waiting for two approvals.

maria: Approving now. 

alex: Approving now. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Promote approved. Promotion started. Estimated time to completion: ~3m.

jamal: Thanks everyone. After promo completes, ops/sophia/maria — let's sync for a short postmortem at 16:00 UTC to capture artifact-registry metrics and runner cache TTL settings.

sophia: I'll gather logs and metrics.

ops: Promo completed successfully. Release is live on prod with pinned image.

maria: Release notes updated: added note about pin + follow-up PM.

jamal: Closing the hold. We'll file a follow-up ticket for the cache TTL and registry upload errors.
